comment: The one input is configured as configInput(INPUT_SIGNAL, "TODO") at src/Spectrogram.cpp:110, so Rack's own tooltip for that jack reads TODO. The parameter the panel prints as Y SCALE is the frequency scale, FrequencyScale Linear or Logarithmic, named "Y Scale" because the spectrogram draws frequency up the image rather than across it; the analyzer in the same plugin uses the same enumeration for its X SCALE. The shipped manual for Spectre is the Fourier manual with the module name left as Fourier in its header, and it documents Length, Hop, X-Scale and a magnitude Y-Scale, none of which exist on this panel: the FFT length is fixed at 2048 and the history at 512 columns (src/Spectrogram.cpp:27-28), and the only Y Scale is the frequency one. There are no outputs. Index order matches panel order.
